overview: The Italforni BLM "THE BULL" Tempered Stained Glass Medium Electric Pizza Oven is an incredibly powerful and visually stunning centerpiece for any restaurant or premium catering establishment. Engineered from strong Italian steel and fully coated in coloured shock and high temperature resistant tempered glass, THE BULL is sure to make an impact and add wow factor with it's unique and characterful design.

With a generous capacity of up to nine 30cm pizza or two baking trays, each BLM pizza oven features a cooking chamber fully lined with refractory brick containing armoured “hy·pe” heating elements and offering a maximum cooking temperature of 450°C. The oven's outstanding thermal insulation ensures it's external temperature reaches a maximum of 30°C while in use. Each oven deck has heavy duty counterbalanced doors with tempered double glazed glass windows and is lit internally by high resistance, high capacity halogen lighting. Operation is simple and easy thanks to the unit's intuitive TOUCH control board and digital display.

THE BULL is modular and fully customisable, with the ability to stack up to three pizza oven decks, a choice of proving unit bases or stands and of course the oven's signature hood. The oven comes in black or red as standard, but can be customised with any RAL colour and even personalised with your own unique designs to complement your restaurant's decor. Site surveys are available to help plan your installation - take a look at a kitchen refit project featuring the Italforni BULL Pizza Oven or call our sales team now to find out more.
Fully customisable - choose from a variety of options, sizes and colours to suit your individual business needs.

Engineered from strong Italian steel and fully coated in coloured shock and high temperature resistant tempered glass, THE BULL is sure to make an impact and add wow factor with it's unique and characterful design.

THE BULL is modular and fully customisable, with the ability to stack up to three pizza oven decks, a choice of proving unit bases or stands and of course the oven's signature hood. The oven comes in black or red as standard, but can be customised with any RAL colour and even personalised with your own unique designs to complement your restaurant's decor. Site surveys are available to help plan your installation - take a look at a kitchen refit project featuring the Italforni BULL Pizza Oven or call our sales team now to find out more.
